thesis: Sam Hinkie argues that effective interviewing requires avoiding hyper-scripted questions to instead probe deeply into how a candidate perceives the world and understands the limits of their own knowledge. He values candidates who can acknowledge they are not experts on a topic and respect that there are deeper levels of understanding they have not yet reached.
